name: SpendLogic — Procurement-Compliance Documentation Templating
description: Cadocary designed and implemented an end-to-end procurement-compliance documentation templating engine for SpendLogic, guiding federal contractors through the CPSR documentation that keeps their purchasing systems audit-ready.
engagementRole: Cadocary served as the software design and implementation consultancy for this engagement — delivering white-glove, end-to-end product implementation that is better and cheaper at once.
deliverable: an end-to-end procurement-compliance documentation templating engine.

body.text: Federal contractors and agencies live under the Contractor Purchasing System Review (CPSR) — a high-stakes audit of how they document and justify their purchasing decisions. The documentation is voluminous, unforgiving, and easy to get subtly wrong.

Assembled by hand, that paperwork becomes compliance roulette: every buyer formats price analyses differently, source justifications drift out of policy, and a single inconsistent SpendFile can put an entire purchasing system's approval at risk.

Cadocary started inside the compliance workflow rather than the code. We mapped how a compliant purchase file actually comes together — the price analyses, source justifications, and supporting records a CPSR reviewer expects to see — and where practitioners lose time or introduce risk.

From that model we designed a guided templating engine: instead of blank documents, buyers answer structured prompts and the system produces standardized, policy-aligned documentation every time. The compliance expertise is encoded once, so it no longer depends on any one person's memory.
We built and implemented the SpendLogic templating engine end to end — the product that turns structured inputs into complete, CPSR-ready documentation.

items: SpendFile documentation folders that assemble a complete, consistent purchase record
Guided price analysis generation with standardized, reviewer-ready formatting
Structured source justifications that stay aligned with purchasing policy
Integration with clients' existing ERP systems, plus a FedRAMP version for government agencies

body.text: SpendLogic reports that its customers achieve a 20:1 ROI and a 100% CPSR pass rate since 2016 — turning purchasing-system reviews from a source of anxiety into a predictable, repeatable outcome.
Backed by 50 years of GovCon experience and integrated with the ERP systems contractors already run, the platform delivers compliance that scales with the business rather than fighting it.

name: Hotels4Truckers — Booking Platform for Truck-Friendly Hotels
description: Cadocary designed and implemented an end-to-end booking platform for Hotels4Truckers across web and native iOS and Android apps, helping truckers find and book hotels with real tractor-trailer parking at member rates.
engagementRole: Cadocary served as the software design and implementation consultancy for this engagement — delivering white-glove, end-to-end product implementation that is better and cheaper at once.
deliverable: an end-to-end booking platform across web and native iOS/Android mobile apps.

body.text: A tractor-trailer needs up to 75 feet of parking. General-purpose hotel booking sites don't know that, so drivers routinely book a room only to arrive somewhere they physically cannot park — and there was no reliable way to filter for hotels that could actually accommodate them.
On top of the parking problem, truckers had no dedicated place to compare rates or capture the loyalty-style discounts that a large, road-bound audience should command.

Cadocary treated the core asset as data: a trucker-friendly hotel database built from scratch, capturing which properties can genuinely handle large-vehicle parking rather than trusting generic listings.

Around that database we designed a cross-platform product — one experience delivered on the web and on native mobile — so drivers can search, compare rates, and book from the cab, and members can access negotiated discounts at partner chains.
We built and implemented the full Hotels4Truckers platform end to end, from the underlying data to the apps drivers hold in their hands.

items: A purpose-built database of trucker-friendly hotels with tractor-trailer parking (up to 75 ft)
Rate comparison and booking flows tuned for on-the-road use
Free membership unlocking 10–15% discounts at partner chains
Native iOS and Android apps sharing the web platform's booking experience

body.text: Hotels4Truckers now offers drivers a single, trusted place to find hotels that can actually park them, compare rates, and book with confidence across web and mobile.
Free membership turns the platform into an everyday tool: members save 10–15% at partner chains, and the from-scratch hotel database keeps the parking guarantee at the center of every booking.

name: PURLPal — RAG Chatbot Over Medicare Advantage Plans
description: Cadocary designed and implemented an end-to-end RAG-enabled chatbot for PURLPal that answers questions over Medicare Advantage plan data, kept current by a webscraping pipeline that ingests plan details as they change.
engagementRole: Cadocary served as the software design and implementation consultancy for this engagement — delivering white-glove, end-to-end product implementation that is better and cheaper at once.
deliverable: an end-to-end RAG-enabled chatbot over Medicare Advantage plans, plus the associated webscraping.

body.text: Medicare Advantage is a maze: thousands of plans, each with its own premiums, networks, drug formularies, and benefit rules, all changing from year to year. Answering a plain-language question like "which plan covers my medication in my area?" means reconciling a vast, constantly shifting body of plan data.
A general chatbot can't be trusted here — it either doesn't know the specifics or invents them. The answers have to be grounded in the actual, current plan details.

Cadocary designed a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline: rather than letting a model answer from memory, the assistant retrieves the relevant Medicare Advantage plan data first and generates its answer strictly from that grounded context.
Because plan data is only useful if it's current, we paired the RAG system with a webscraping and ingestion pipeline that continuously gathers plan information and keeps the knowledge base fresh.
We built and implemented the full PURLPal assistant end to end — both the conversational layer and the data pipeline that feeds it.

items: A webscraping pipeline that collects and normalizes Medicare Advantage plan data
An ingestion and indexing layer that turns that data into a retrievable knowledge base
A RAG-enabled chatbot that retrieves relevant plan details and answers questions grounded in them
A refresh cycle that keeps answers aligned with current plan information

body.text: PURLPal launched as a working assistant that answers Medicare Advantage questions in plain language, grounded in retrieved plan data rather than guesswork.
Because the scraping pipeline keeps the underlying knowledge base current, the chatbot's answers reflect the plan landscape as it actually is, not a stale snapshot.
